title: Examples / Presentations

location.series: IBM Logo Guidelines for Strategic Partners / Version 1.2 / copyright 2023

slide_intent: Separate acknowledgement from authorship so an audience can recognize contributors while remembering whose presentation it is.
strategic_value: Partner-led slide layouts can credit IBM without turning support into an apparent joint brand.
demonstration: An acknowledgement slide groups partner cards beside text; an end slide places the partner identity in a large left field and IBM within the right content area.
practical_value: Choose a contributor grid for several partners or a supporting IBM acknowledgement on the closing slide.

content_islands.name: Acknowledgement slide
content_islands.spec: Show the partner mark and text at left of a four-card contributor grid, with IBM as one card.

content_islands.name: End slide
content_islands.spec: Show a large partner-brand field next to content and a smaller IBM mark.

content_islands.name: Scope note
content_islands.spec: Retain the statement that the examples do not exhaust layout options.

reference_purposes.Application: The two slide schematics distinguish multi-party acknowledgement from a partner-led end slide.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page qualifies these as suggested layouts rather than mandatory templates.
